connector.name: Homey-Wan-Kenobi MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Homey Pro: 60 tools for devices, flows, energy, and Z-Wave/Zigbee diagnostics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image homey-wan-kenobi:2.2.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ringosystems account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HOMEY_TOKEN
env.description: Homey local API key (my.homey.app > Settings > API keys)
